4:15.text: of your women - bring against them four
from among you. And if they testify,
to houses until death takes them or Allāh ordains for them

4:16.text: them both. But if they repent and correct themselves, leave them alone. Indeed, Allāh is ever Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.

4:17.text: The repentance accepted by Allāh is only for those who do wrong in ignorance
It is those to whom Allāh will turn in forgiveness, and Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

4:18.text: do evil deeds up until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "Indeed, I have repented now," or of those who die while they are disbelievers. For them We have prepared a painful punishment.

4:19.text: O you who have believed, it is not lawful for you to inherit women by compulsion.
And do not make difficulties for them in order to take
part of what you gave them
unless they commit a clear immorality
. And live with them in kindness. For if you dislike them - perhaps you dislike a thing and Allāh makes therein much good.
